trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. (First attempt returned a 503; retried successfully.)

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
